_comment: The pinned Projects UI artifact: url + sha256 + source commit. TODAY the artifact is built LOCALLY from an UNPUBLISHED commit of the UI source (source_commit_published=false) and lives in this repository (local_path), so builds and tests are offline and reproducible; no release of redevops-projects has been published for it, so `url` is empty and this record is NOT a source offer (decisions pins-04, pins-10 and D-LIC-12 stay OPEN; packaging/ui-bundle-source.json carries the same provenance). The source commit MERGES the public release v0.2.0 (Today-first views: Today, capture, batch triage, notifications, routing, deployment-inspection and social-intelligence cards) into the local accessibility series (UIA-01..12) and adds the mission drill-down views (Summary, Tasks, Evidence with Inspect, Timeline, Graph, World State, EXPLAIN, Replay). `previous_pin` is the artifact this one replaces (accessibility series only, no Today-first views), which stays in the repository: going back is a lock edit. scripts/fetch_projects_ui.py verifies the sha256 before anything is extracted, whichever source it reads.

merged_public_release.note: public release of redevops-projects, merged into the source commit; not an ancestor of the accessibility series base

recipe.environment: env -i with PATH, throwaway HOME and TMPDIR, LANG and an isolated npm cache; VITE_PROJECTS_API=/ is the only build variable passed; built from a clean `git archive` of source_commit
recipe.pack: scripts/make_projects_ui_artifact.py DIST packaging/ui-artifacts/projects-ui-root-ee958a01.tgz (sorted members, mtime 2020-01-01Z, uid/gid 0, gzip mtime 0; the neutral hero.jpg of this repository replaces the UI repository's public/hero.jpg)
recipe.reproduced: index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS were built three times from a clean `git archive` of source_commit, each in its own throwaway HOME, TMPDIR and npm cache under env -i (node v24.22.2, npm 11.19.1, npm ci), on 2026-11-06 with identical sha256; three consecutive packs give an identical archive. The archive bytes also depend on the zlib in use; the member hashes above are the portable invariant, the archive sha256 is what is pinned.

previous_pin.note: the accessibility series (UIA-01..12) on the old public base 5114b560 only: it does NOT contain the Today-first views and has one shared body for every mission tab. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

public release asset fetched by origin/main; Today-first UI (Today, capture, batch triage, notifications, routing, deployment-inspection and social-intelligence cards). The accessibility series (UIA-01..12) is NOT in it and the Today-first views are NOT in the current artifact.
